notes.title: Bigger Guns is now Free!
notes.content:
A lot has been done in this update to improve Bigger Guns.
The network is very important in online matches, and the entire system has been improved. Smaller data sizes and faster connections with global cloud servers that will allow players from around the world to play together like they were next door. 
This update also includes new modes with workshop maps.
You can now start any kind of online match and play with your friends on the map you created.
The in-game camera can now be adjusted from 10 to 90 degrees, so basically you can play with a side view, top-down, or somewhere between, it's up to you.

And now the best for last, Bigger Guns is now [b]Free[/b]!

An [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1230910/Bigger_Guns__Expansion_Pack/]Expansion Pack[/url] was released today and can be purchased by a small amount, to support the dev, and all the current owners of the base game will have that content already available.
So, everyone who has purchased the paid version until today will receive the new content automatically in-game and can start enjoying the new features right now (check the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1230910/Bigger_Guns__Expansion_Pack/]DLC page[/url] for more info on the new content).

Have Fun!

notes.title: Bigger Guns 1.2 Update
notes.content:
[b]Bigger Guns is now 1.2 and includes a Voxel Map Editor ![/b]

Fully integrated into the game, the map builder allows you to build and upload directly to the Steam Workshop.

Any map you create can then be used to play in Deathmatch, Battle Royale, or just hang out in open sandbox.

[list]
[*] Integrated Workshop Browser - Subscribe, Download and Vote directly ingame
[/list]
[list]
[*] Workshop Map Builder - Create Maps with thousands of voxels, with great performance and limited download size
[/list]
[list]
[*] Open Sandbox - Hangout, build and chat with your friends
[/list]

notes.title: Bigger Guns 1.1 Update
notes.content:
Bigger Guns is now 1.1 !

[list]
[*] Battle Royale - New Mode in a fast BR style
[*] Match Rewards - Prizes for the Deathmatch and BR winners
[*] BG Friends - Add friends inside the game and join them in a match
[*] Leaderboard - 10 Points for each Battle Royale and DM Win
[/list]
